sql.processStep.getAllForCompany: select ps.id, ps.process_step_name, ps.company_id, ps.archived, ps.date_created, ps.date_updated, ps.created_by_id, ps.modified_by_id from flow.process_step ps where ps.company_id = :companyId and ps.archived is not true
sql.processStep.get: select ps.id, ps.process_step_name, ps.company_id, ps.archived, ps.date_created, ps.date_updated, ps.created_by_id, ps.modified_by_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT psl.id, psl.link_id as "linkId", psl.created_by_id as "createdById", psl.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", l.link, l.url, psl.archived FROM flow.process_step_link psl inner join flow.link l on l.id = psl.link_id WHERE psl.process_step_id = ps.id AND psl.archived is not true) links), '[]') AS "links", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(attachmentTypes))) FROM ( SELECT psat.id, psat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", psat.created_by_id as "createdById", psat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", psat.archived FROM flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id WHERE psat.process_step_id = ps.id AND psat.archived is not true) attachmentTypes), '[]') AS "attachmentTypes", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(cfGroups))) FROM ( SELECT cfgt.id, cfgt.group_name as "groupName", cfgt.object_type_id as "objectTypeId", cfgt.archived, cfgt.group_order as "groupOrder", cfgt.process_step_id as "processStepId", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfg.id, cfg.custom_field_group_type_id as "customFieldGroupTypeId", cfg.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfg.ancillary_custom_field_group_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupId", cfg.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfg.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id WHERE cfg.custom_field_group_type_id = cfgt.id AND cfg.archived is not true union all SELECT cfg.id, cfg.custom_field_group_type_id as "customFieldGroupTypeId", cfg.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfg.ancillary_custom_field_group_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupId", cfg.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfg.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg2 on cfg2.id = cfg.ancillary_custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg2.custom_field_id WHERE cfg.custom_field_group_type_id = cfgt.id AND cfg.archived is not true) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" FROM flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt WHERE cfgt.process_step_id = ps.id AND cfgt.archived is not true) cfGroups), '[]') AS custom_field_group_types from flow.process_step ps where ps.id = :id
sql.processStep.delete: update flow.process_step set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_updated = now() where id = :id
sql.processStep.update: update flow.process_step set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_updated = now(), process_step_name = :name where id = :id;
sql.processStep.insert: insert into flow.process_step (company_id, process_step_name, created_by_id) values (:companyId, :name, :createdById)
sql.processStep.getParentObjects: select * from flow.process_step where id != :id and company_id = :companyId and archived is not true order by process_step_name
